title: 2024 law protecting ICIG whistleblowers who disclose CIA and DOE secrets

tellings.quote: whistleblowers going to the ICIG, uh, if they disclose CIA secrets and Department of Energy secrets, they're not allowed to be prosecuted for espionage."

plain: A law passed in 2024 means that whistleblowers who bring CIA or Department of Energy secrets to the ICIG, the inspector general who takes complaints from inside the intelligence agencies, cannot be prosecuted for espionage. That is how the researcher Dylan Borland reads the legislation, which he summarises for Michels without quoting it. If his reading holds, insiders with secret UFO knowledge could come forward through that office without risking espionage charges.
